value.en: Draftie is an experimental product design project that combines a dedicated hardware controller, the Draftie Board, with a software writing editor. Users import AI-generated text through a browser extension, and the editor compares it with the evolving draft to identify retained word combinations and sentence structures. Sentence-level highlights reveal these traces, while a document-wide percentage, the screen background, and the board’s LEDs communicate the overall revision state. By encouraging users to revise the text in their own words until the highlights disappear, Draftie explores the conditions under which authorship takes shape in human–AI co-writing.

value.en: Today, generative AI participates throughout this process in different ways. People edit sentences written by AI, and AI reviews texts that people have revised. From technical reports and academic writing to journalism, writing is becoming a collaborative activity in which human and AI linguistic choices overlap. Authorship is no longer a given within this process. To make a collaboratively produced text their own, people revise content that does not reflect their intentions, add sentences that express their voice, and reconsider its wording and structure. Revision becomes both a decision of refining a text and a means of maintaining, reclaiming, and defending authorship.
value.ko: 이 프로젝트는 그러한 변형 과정을 인터랙티브 웹 디자인으로 시각화합니다. 사용자가 사이트에 문장을 직접 입력하고 엔터를 누르는 순간, 텍스트는 배경에 흡수되어 겹겹이 쌓입니다. 누적된 문장들은 공처럼 비어 있는 구멍에 의해 뚫리며, 이 구멍은 사이트 위를 떠다니는 입자 형태와 호응합니다.

value.en: In conventional computer environments, text written by the user and text brought in from AI become intermingled through the same hardware operations, browser tabs, and documents. Draftie separates the process of importing and managing AI text from this existing workflow. Importing is assigned to the dedicated board, while reviewing and revising the imported text takes place in the dedicated editor. The application runs only when the board is connected and closes when it is disconnected. Importing and exporting also take place through the board. This deliberately restricted structure creates a separate workflow in which users can examine the source and revision status of AI text before it enters their existing writing environment.

value.en: Highlight colours distinguish the source models, while their intensity indicates how much of the original language remains. The palette begins with yellow, the familiar colour of a highlighter, followed by blue, pink, and green. Passages that retain more of the original construction receive stronger highlights, while those retaining only some elements are marked more lightly. Highlights disappear where the reconstruction criteria are met. Hovering over a highlight reveals the model information and import time associated with that passage. Pressing the second button hides the highlights so users can focus on the writing itself; pressing it again brings the revision feedback back into view.

value.en: Draftie separates the route through which AI language enters a draft and makes its subsequent revision visible. As users revise, they repeatedly encounter what they have retained and what they have changed. What does it mean to choose a linguistic structure for oneself? At what point does AI-generated writing become one’s own? How much must be changed, and in what ways, before a writer can regard the text as their own? By placing these questions within the experience of writing, the project explores the conditions under which authorship takes shape in texts created by humans and AI together.

value.en:
**Play music while brushing your teeth with family and friends.**
The angle, direction, and speed of your brushing become sound. Brush up and down to make melody. Move faster to alter the character of the sound. Simply open the app and choose a score, and your three minutes of brushing turns into a small band performance created together.
With Teethplay, a toothbrush can become a musical instrument at any moment. Fill your brushing routine with music.
value.ko: 가족들, 친구들과 함께 양치질을 하며 음악을 연주해보세요. 칫솔질의 각도, 방향, 속도는 그대로 소리가 됩니다. 위아래로 닦으면 음이 오르내리고, 빠르게 움직이면 소리가 달라집니다. 앱을 켜고 악보를 선택하면, 양치질하는 3분을 짧은 우리만의 밴드 공연으로 만들 수 있습니다. Teethplay를 통해 칫솔은 언제든지 악기가 됩니다. 양치질하는 시간을 음악으로 채워나가보세요.

value.en:
**Motion Based Sound Generation**
The toothbrush detects its tilt, direction, and movement speed in real time, transforming them into pitch, timbre, and volume.

**Score Mode**
Follow a score stored in the app while brushing, and melodies designed around the rhythm of your movements will play back as you go. By the time you finish following the score, a three minute piece of music will have reached its finale.

**Family Band**
Connect multiple devices and each person's brushing becomes part of a shared harmony. Brush your teeth together with family and friends while performing as an ensemble.
value.ko:
**모션 기반 사운드 생성**
칫솔의 기울기, 방향, 움직임 속도를 실시간으로 감지해 음높이, 음색, 음량으로 변환합니다.

**스코어 모드**
앱에 저장된 스코어에 맞춰 양치질을 수행하면 움직임의 리듬에 맞춰 설계된 멜로디가 재생됩니다. 악보를 따라 이를 닦다보면 어느덧 3분짜리 음악이 끝나있을 거예요.

**패밀리 밴드**
여러 기기를 연결하면 각자의 칫솔질이 화음으로 조합됩니다. 가족, 친구들과 함께 이를 닦으며 합주를 해보세요.

value.en:
Some three minutes feel endless. Brushing your teeth is something you are expected to do several times a day, every day, for three minutes at a time. It is easy to become bored or distracted. We check our phones, rush through the routine, or neglect the hard to reach areas.

But think about what happens when you play an instrument or listen to music. Within the structure of a score, you follow a set of movements for a set amount of time. As you do, the music unfolds and a complete piece gradually takes shape.

Careful tooth brushing and musical performance may share more in common than they first appear. Both require precise actions performed according to a set of rules over a defined period of time. Teethplay began with the curiosity of bringing these two activities together. If brushing itself became a performance, could those same three minutes become something more enjoyable?
value.ko:
어떤 3분은 너무 길고, 어떤 3분은 너무 짧습니다. 양치질은 3분동안 매일, 몇 번씩 해야합니다. 쉽게 지루해지고, 귀찮아지죠. 그래서 딴짓을 하거나, 대충 끝내거나, 구석구석 닦지 않게 되는 등 소홀해지기 일쑤입니다.

하지만 악기를 연주하거나 음악을 들을 땐 어떤가요? 악보라는 규칙 안에서 정해진 동작을 정해진 시간 동안 수행하다보면 음악이 진행되고, 한 곡이 완성됩니다.

꼼꼼한 양치질과 완성된 음악 연주는 구조적으로 닮아있을지도 모릅니다. 규칙에 맞춰 정해진 시간동안 정확하게 동작을 수행해야 하죠. 이 둘을 겹쳐보면 어떨까 하는 호기심으로부터 Teethplay가 구상되었습니다. 칫솔질 자체가 연주가 된다면, 같은 3분이라도 더 즐거워지지 않을까요?
